name: Restore
overview: Scripture reveals restoration as a divine act of renewal and healing, where God revives the soul, restores joy, and brings health to those who are broken or cast aside. The Lord is portrayed as a restorer of life and a nourisher in old age, faithfully renewing strength even after great troubles. Believers are encouraged to delight in the Lord, trusting that He will fulfill the desires of their hearts and uphold them by His Spirit. This restoration is both spiritual and physical, demonstrating God's compassion and power to heal wounds and revive hope.
